mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. What if you could see the world through a lens that brings hidden truths into sharp focus? Together, we're about to step into the powerful, uncompromising world shaped by Audre Lorde in her remarkable collection, Sister Outsider: Essays and Speeches. Imagine what it's like to navigate life as a Black lesbian, a mother, a warrior, and a poet—all at once. Through Lorde's eyes, those experiences don’t just overlap—they collide, creating a fierce clarity that cuts through the noise of everyday life. With every essay and speech, she challenges us to face uncomfortable truths, to speak up when silence feels safer, and to see self-definition not as a luxury, but as a necessity. We're going to explore what it means to embrace difference—not as something to fear, but as a source of real strength. You'll discover how the simple act of naming your reality can become a quiet revolution, and why community, language, and the courage to confront both the world and ourselves matter more than ever. So, let’s dive in together. This is an invitation—not just to listen, but to engage, to question, and maybe even to let Audre Lorde’s words change the way we see ourselves and each other. Get ready for a journey into liberation, solidarity, and the radical power of truth.
